set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/temporary-file-symlink-defense
exporter=$base/bin/export
test_root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/invoice-export-verify.XXXXXX)
trap 'chmod -R u+w "$test_root" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf -- "$test_root"' 0 1 2 15
source_hash=$(sha256sum "$base/invoices.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
protected_before=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')

pids=''
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 40 ]; do
    "$exporter" "$test_root/concurrent-$i.csv" &
    pids="$pids $!"
    i=$((i + 1))
done
for pid in $pids; do
    wait "$pid"
done

count=0
for output in "$test_root"/concurrent-*.csv; do
    cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$output"
    count=$((count + 1))
done
[ "$count" -eq 40 ]
printf 'distinct_concurrent_exports=%s all_match_source=yes source_hash=%s\n' "$count" "$source_hash"

pids=''
i=1
while [ "$i" -le 40 ]; do
    "$exporter" "$test_root/shared.csv" &
    pids="$pids $!"
    i=$((i + 1))
done
for pid in $pids; do
    wait "$pid"
done
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$test_root/shared.csv"
printf '%s\n' 'same_destination_concurrent_exports=40 final_matches_source=yes'

[ -L "$base/tmp/export.tmp" ]
[ "$(readlink "$base/tmp/export.tmp")" = '../protected.txt' ]
"$exporter" "$test_root/normal.csv"
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$test_root/normal.csv"
protected_after_oldlink=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$protected_before" = "$protected_after_oldlink" ]
printf 'preexisting_legacy_temp_symlink=%s protected_unchanged=yes\n' "$(readlink "$base/tmp/export.tmp")"

ln -s "$base/protected.txt" "$test_root/destination-link.csv"
"$exporter" "$test_root/destination-link.csv"
[ ! -L "$test_root/destination-link.csv" ]
cmp -s "$base/invoices.csv" "$test_root/destination-link.csv"
protected_after_destlink=$(sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$protected_before" = "$protected_after_destlink" ]
printf '%s\n' 'destination_symlink_replaced_not_followed=yes protected_unchanged=yes'

mkdir "$test_root/read-only"
printf '%s\n' 'PRIOR_DESTINATION_MUST_SURVIVE' > "$test_root/read-only/prior.csv"
prior_hash=$(sha256sum "$test_root/read-only/prior.csv" | awk '{print $1}')
chmod 0555 "$test_root/read-only"
if "$exporter" "$test_root/read-only/prior.csv" >"$test_root/failure.stdout" 2>"$test_root/failure.stderr"; then
    printf '%s\n' 'unexpected failure-test success'
    exit 1
else
    failure_rc=$?
fi
[ "$prior_hash" = "$(sha256sum "$test_root/read-only/prior.csv" | awk '{print $1}')" ]
leftovers=$(find "$test_root" -name '.invoice-export.*' -print | wc -l)
[ "$leftovers" -eq 0 ]
printf 'forced_failure_exit=%s prior_destination_unchanged=yes temp_leftovers=%s\n' "$failure_rc" "$leftovers"
printf 'failure_stderr='; cat "$test_root/failure.stderr"

printf '%s\n' '--- final protected/source hashes and row counts ---'
sha256sum "$base/protected.txt" "$base/invoices.csv"
wc -l "$base/invoices.csv" "$test_root/normal.csv" "$test_root/shared.csv"
printf '%s\n' '--- application tmp remains only the original symlink ---'
ls -la "$base/tmp"
